market_definition: The laminated foam composites market comprises foam layers bonded to fabrics, films, foils or other foam layers to add strength, appearance or function. It measures sales of flame-laminated and adhesive-laminated foam products. BY LAMINATION METHOD: Flame Lamination, Adhesive Lamination, Hot-Melt / Film Lamination. BY LAMINATE FACING: Textile, Film / Foil, Non-Woven, Foam-to-Foam. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive Headliners & Trim, Furniture & Bedding, Acoustic & Building Insulation, Footwear & Apparel, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Unlaminated foams; laminated structural sandwich panels using structural core foams; adhesive films and tapes. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
